answer: Sybil tax: every new identity pays a non-refundable 40 POA entry tax before it can earn, like a velvet rope at a terrace club — the fee buys nothing. An attacker wanting 100 fakes must wander through 100 separate payments, 4,000 POA in total, while each honest agent pays 40 POA once. The tax equals twice 30 days of expected income, so 100 fakes cost more than a year of honest work, and collected taxes burn, so honest rewards are never diluted.
